sloka: वर्षं चतुर्दशं चैव ततो हेममयं पुरम् ।वज्रवैडूर्यचित्रं च मायया निर्मितं मया ।। ७.१२.८ ॥
transliteration: varṣaṁ caturdaśaṁ caiva tato hemamayaṁ puram ।vajravaiḍūryacitraṁ ca māyayā nirmitaṁ mayā ।। 7.12.8 ॥

translations.english: Then, for the fourteenth year, a golden city, adorned with diamonds and lapis lazuli, was created by me through illusion.
